reviewNotes: Initial launch batch, reviewed 2026-11-16 against the archived letter (unchanged on Costco's index that day). States are proved by the warehouse list's 'City, ST' postal codes. No photo and no package codes in the letter, so Affected Products is omitted. FDA Enforcement Report records the same recall as H-0682-2026 (Kirkland Signature Traditional Madeleines, item 2000012), firm Costco Wholesale Corporation, Class I, Terminated; Lotly holds no agency case for it.

fields.whatHappened: Traditional Madeleines sold at Costco were packaged with Madeleines filled with Chocolate Hazelnut. The mislabeled units contain undeclared tree nuts (hazelnut/filbert) and soy.
instructions: If you are allergic to hazelnuts/filberts or soy, do not eat this product.
Return it to Costco for a full refund.
